rationale: The customer said the code began right after wet-cleaning the panel, yet the assistant never suggested drying the panel or isolating power at the cooker switch, which would have fixed it. It pointed toward a PCB or display fault, gave an irrelevant power-cut/MANUAL clock instruction, and asked a generic question that ignored what the customer had already said. It then escalated to an engineer prematurely, with no useful context and no simple checks. Escalation was unnecessary, since the fault was moisture on the panel registering as a held key (E011).
